docs: Wishlist appids Steam intermittently filters out of https://store.steampowered.com/search/results/?filter=popularwishlist despite the game being in the public wishlist ranking (verified via SteamDB and the Steam client's public wishlist view). Ported from howmanyareplaying/backend/src/data/wishlistManualAppids.json 2026-08-21. Only pre-release Saber-published titles with a Steam App ID are eligible here — non-Saber titles are handled upstream by hmap. Kept byte-for-byte-compatible with the hmap schema so a future consolidation into a shared package is trivial.
logo_convention: Use Steam's stable header.jpg key art (460x215): https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/{APPID}/header.jpg — verified 200 OK for any appid without needing the per-build hash that capsule_sm_120.jpg requires. This matches hmap's convention exactly.

appids.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
appids.notes: Silently filtered from popularwishlist despite ranking #155 on SteamDB and Steam client public wishlist view. Steam-side cause verified 2026-08-21 (hmap): content_descriptors.ids = [1,2,4,5] (descriptor 4 = Adult Only Sexual Content) plus country bans (steam_germany BANNED, igrs Indonesia BANNED). Even with ignore_preferences=1 and cookieless requests across every cc (US/DE/JP/GB/IN/AU/CN/RU) and every page (0..5200), the appid is absent — not a top-200 issue. seed_rank=155 matches the observed public rank on 2026-08-21 and is used only until SignalPulse itself has observed a rank for this appid.
